steps.text: 'It should be almost winter where you are by the time this letter arrives.'
'I imagine winter in Ursus is even harsher.'
'I hope you can come back sooner rather than later.'
'I hope you haven't been dragged into the mess over there.'
'One last friendly reminder.'
'I know your style, but don't get too involved.'
'Good luck, Lord.'

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: 'Don't get too involved'?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: It's a little too late for that.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Sigh.
Alexsandr looks at the device before him, sighs, and puts away the letter.
His breath turns to white fog in the cool air.
It is a strange piece of machinery, with roughly polished metal rails and slightly rusted plates.
Alexsandr carefully maneuvers a wooden crane, putting in the finishing touches next to the strange device.
An Originium engine hangs beneath the crane, the last piece of the puzzle for this strange device.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Done!

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Coupling, check. Where's my wrench?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Where on Earth is my level?
The soldier reaches into a box and takes out a level made from birch and glass, calibrating the connection between the engine and the machine.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Let's see...

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Power supply, check. Voltage...

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Where am I supposed to find a voltmeter in this place?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: How the hell did they do this in the 50s?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: This torque better be enough.
After a few minutes, the sound of machine rumbling begins to echo in the warehouse.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Aha!

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: There we go! Hahaha!

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: It's moving! It's moving!

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: Mr. Alexsandr?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Good morning, Mr. Alsu.

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: You're up early.

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: Oh, it finally started?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: I know, right? It's been two frustrating months, but at least it paid off.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Too bad we're out of booze. Who knows when the next caravan is coming.

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: They don't like going out too far in winter.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Using this machine, I'll be able to make some simple parts even without the caravans.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: We could fix that hand pump, for example.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: We can teach the others how to use it. It'll make life a lot easier.

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: What do you call it... a lathe?

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: I've heard my son talking about it.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: I've been here a while now, but I've never met your son.

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: He doesn't work too far from here, but it's on the other side of the mountain, and the roads get really bad in winter.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: The east side? There's a mining zone over there... owned by a nomadic city, I think?

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: Looks like you know the area.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: I asked some questions when trading with that drifter group.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: I might have to go again in a few days. Let's hope the snow isn't too bad.

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: You should stay away from the wastelanders for a while...

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: The taxmen are coming soon. There'll be trouble if they find out we were dealing with the wastelanders.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Trouble?

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: I don't know about other places, but Lord Fetisov doesn't like us talking to them too much.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: People from the army say that many of them are Kazimierzian spies.

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: Along with outlaws like the Rusthammers.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: I see.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: But most of the drifters in that group look like Ursus people.

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: It didn't use to be that way...

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: In the past, wastelanders mostly came from outside Ursus. They were quickly chased away by Lord Fetisov's guards.

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: But now...

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: Plenty of Ursus have been fleeing their villages and joining the drifters.

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: We had more than two hundred people in this village a few years ago, but so many ran in the last couple of years.

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: There's no one left to till the soil, and the traders aren't coming anymore.

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: The only thing that's increasing is taxes...

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Your standard formula for depopulation.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: What about your Lord Fetisov? Does he just sit on his thumb while his serfs run away?

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: I... I'm not sure.

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: But he's probably busy dealing with the highwaymen up north.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Highwaymen?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Oh, the bandits the villagers have been talking about?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Who exactly are they?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: It's been a month. What is your lord doing?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Ursus's armies wouldn't have trouble with common bandits, would they?

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: I'm not sure, but rumors say that they're well-trained, targeting nobles specifically. They're even attacking the army.

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: I don't know how bandits manage to do that...

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Well-trained 'bandits' fighting against the nobility. I've heard that story before.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Too many times.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: What do they say? History repeats itself.

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: Er, you've seen this before?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Oh, no, just an off-hand comment

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Old man! What are you doing here? They're all looking for you!

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: Take your time, catch your breath.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: You need to hurry home! Your son...

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: My son's back?

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: Wait... why?

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Just go! He's in bad shape!

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Woman
steps.text: Alsu! You're here! Your son...

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: What happened to my son?

steps.name: Woman
steps.text: I was getting firewood in the morning when I saw someone lying at the south edge of town.

steps.name: Woman
steps.text: I realized it was Anwar when I got closer.

steps.name: Woman
steps.text: Who knows what might have happened if I didn't stumble across him.

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: Thank you so much.

steps.name: Woman
steps.text: I bandaged up wounds. There's no frostbite, so I guess he wasn't there for too long.

steps.name: Woman
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Woman
steps.text: Listen to me carefully... your son has Oripathy.

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Woman
steps.text: Look at his shoulder.

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: Oh my...
The old man takes a step back in shock.
In the span of a few seconds, a multitude of expressions flash across his face - fear, worry, doubt.
At last, it settles on sorrow.

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: Who else knows?

steps.name: Woman
steps.text: I haven't told anyone yet.

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: Please, I beg you...

steps.name: Woman
steps.text: I know. He's your only son.

steps.name: Woman
steps.text: I'll tell people he has wet flu, tell them to stay away from your house for a few days.

steps.name: Woman
steps.text: But this is Oripathy. You know what I mean, right? You have some thinking to do.

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: Thank you... very much...

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Doesn't look good?

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: M-Mr. Alexsandr?

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: Y-You shouldn't be here... my son...

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Oripathy, right?

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: Mr. Alexsandr...

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Don't worry. I'm here to help.

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: But... it's Oripathy...

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: It's fine. I've seen plenty of Oripathy patients.

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Take off his shirt and rub this on the crystalline regions.

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: This is...

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Like I said, I've seen my share of Oripathy patients. Do as I say.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: This is for injection. Give me a hand; I need to get some hot water.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: If the crystals begin to seep blood, drip it on this piece of test paper.

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: As you say...
A few minutes later.

steps.name: Young Man
steps.text: Where... where am I...

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: Anwar! You're awake!

steps.name: Anwar
steps.text: D-Dad? How did I...?

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: It's fine, don't speak, I'm just glad you're back...

steps.name: Anwar
steps.text: Is this... home?

steps.name: Anwar
steps.text: No, I can't stay here! I have Oripathy! I...

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: I know, I know. Say no more.

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: Sani was the one who found you. She didn't tell anyone else.

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: I'll take you into the woods once you're better.

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: There's an abandoned hunter's hut there. You can stay there while we figure out what to do.

steps.name: Anwar
steps.text: Dad... I...

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: It's fine.

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: Rest for a bit, while I get you water. Stay put.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: You're awake?

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: Y-You're a mercenary! Why are you in the village?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Don't worry, I'm a friend of your father's.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Your Oripathy is relatively mild.

steps.name: Anwar
steps.text: I've never seen you before...

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: The name is Alexsandr. I came this year.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: What happened? I thought you were working at the factory.

steps.name: Anwar
steps.text: There was a boiler explosion two weeks ago.

steps.name: Anwar
steps.text: A few of us came down with Oripathy...

steps.name: Anwar
steps.text: So the overseer kicked us out.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: That's all? Were you followed?

steps.name: Anwar
steps.text: We thought we were being followed at first, but we stopped paying attention after a few days.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: I wouldn't expect them to let you go so easily...

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Never mind. Get some rest.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Are you okay?

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: Mr. Alexsandr... what can I do?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: You face reality.

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: But... it's Oripathy...

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: A mild case of it. There are many ways to control the symptoms.

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: How do you know so much about it?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: It's a long story. There's a more pressing issue right now.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Life in Ursus will not be easy for your son, even if his symptoms are mild.

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: Argh...

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: He'll need to learn to live like the wastelanders.

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Like hunters that catch manglers in the wild, he will need to learn to fend for himself.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: I can teach him a few things.
A week later...

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Steady...

steps.name: Anwar
steps.text: (Focuses)

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Steady...

steps.name: Anwar
steps.text: (Pulls trigger)

steps.name: Anwar
steps.text: Argh! I missed...

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Don't squeeze the trigger too hard. It'll throw off the bolt's trajectory.

steps.name: Anwar
steps.text: I guess I'm just not cut out for this...

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: It's too early for that. You've made decent progress, considering it's only been a week.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Live targets are a different animal altogether. Practice makes perfect.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: One hour break, then it's physical training.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: You have a lot to learn, if you want to survive in the wild.

steps.name: Anwar
steps.text: You know so much, Mr. Alexsandr... did you used to be a soldier?

steps.name: Anwar
steps.text: You're a far cry from the typical Ursus soldier.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: I'm still a soldier.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Where's your dad? It's almost noon.

steps.name: Anwar
steps.text: Maybe he got held up by something?

steps.name: Sani
steps.text: Anwar! Pack your things, now!

steps.name: Anwar
steps.text: What's going on?

steps.name: Sani
steps.text: No time! The Infected Patrol Unit is in the village! They've gone to your house!

steps.name: Anwar
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Sani
steps.text: Pack your things and get out of here! This place is too close to the village. They'll be here any minute!

steps.name: Anwar
steps.text: What about dad? I can't leave him...

steps.name: Sani
steps.text: Just go! The whole village will be in trouble if they find you!

steps.name: Sani
steps.text: Run!

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: How many?

steps.name: Sani
steps.text: Two inspectors and five brawlers. They look like they're out for blood.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: They're all Ursus?

steps.name: Sani
steps.text: The two inspectors are, I think. Not sure about the others.

steps.name: Sani
steps.text: Anyway, this is no time to chat. You should get out of here too, Mr. Alexsandr.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Anwar, take your weapon and put on the camo. You're coming with me.

steps.name: Anwar
steps.text: ...Alright.

steps.name: Infected Patrol Unit
steps.text: Well? Where is he?

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: He... he didn't...

steps.name: Infected Patrol Unit
steps.text: Don't give me that. We saw him come into the village. Hand him over.

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: I-I never saw him!

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: I swear! It's all true!

steps.name: Infected Patrol Unit
steps.text: Do I look stupid to you?

steps.name: Infected Patrol Unit
steps.text: If your son's not here, whose overalls and boots are those? Huh?

steps.name: Infected Patrol Unit
steps.text: Fine don't talk. We've got plenty of time.

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: Please, take me! I'll do hard labor for Lord Fetisov! I'll do anything!

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: Please, just let my son go!

steps.name: Infected Patrol Unit
steps.text: Pfft. You think hard labor's gonna do it?

steps.name: Infected Patrol Unit
steps.text: Round up everyone in the village.

steps.name: Mercenary
steps.text: Aye.

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: W-What are you doing?

steps.name: Infected Patrol Unit
steps.text: What are we doing? Harboring the Infected is a serious crime.

steps.name: Infected Patrol Unit
steps.text: In the name of Lord Fetisov, all your lands are now forfeit!

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: We don't know anything about it! This doesn't have anything to do with us!

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: We didn't do anything!

steps.name: Mercenary
steps.text: Shut your trap and fall in line!

steps.name: Anwar
steps.text: Oh no... I knew this would happen...

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: So that's what they're doing.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Letting the Infected escape on purpose, following them home, all in order to enslave free peasants and confiscate their land.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: The perfect excuse.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: This, too, is an old story.

steps.name: Anwar
steps.text: I'll get those criminals, if that's the last thing I do!

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Hold on. Don't make any hasty moves.

steps.name: Anwar
steps.text: You have a plan?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Go to the high ground to the east of the village and stay out of sight.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Fire at the brawlers on my signal.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Doesn't matter if you miss. I'll take care of the rest.

steps.name: Anwar
steps.text: Gotcha.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Time to clean up.

steps.name: Mercenary
steps.text: House to house? Are you serious?

steps.name: Infected Patrol Unit
steps.text: Cut the crap and go. You're being paid for a reason.

steps.name: Mercenary
steps.text: Fine...

steps.name: Mercenary
steps.text: Someone's shooting at us!

steps.name: Infected Patrol Unit
steps.text: What?! From where?

steps.name: Mercenary
steps.text: East side! On that hill!

steps.name: Infected Patrol Unit
steps.text: You two! Go around and get him!

steps.name: Infected Patrol Unit
steps.text: Take cover! Take cover!

steps.name: Mercenary
steps.text: What the hell's going on?!

steps.name: Infected Patrol Unit
steps.text: What are you doing? Return fire!

steps.name: Infected Patrol Unit
steps.text: No! No!

steps.name: Infected Patrol Unit
steps.text: Where is everybody?

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: There is no one else.

steps.name: Infected Patrol Unit
steps.text: My leg! My leg!

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Stay down.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Or test my patience. Your choice.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Mr. Alsu.

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: M-Mr. Alexsandr！

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Tell everyone else to go indoors and stay there.

steps.name: Alsu
steps.text: A-Alright.

steps.name: Infected Patrol Unit
steps.text: H-How dare you... peasants...

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Not so cocky now that it's just you, eh?

steps.name: Infected Patrol Unit
steps.text: Y-You'll pay for this!

steps.name: Infected Patrol Unit
steps.text: Colonel Lomono's unit is just over the hill!

steps.name: Infected Patrol Unit
steps.text: Lord Fetisov won't let this go unpunished! You're dead, you hear me? Dead!

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Nobles, magnates, boyars.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Is this the best that Ursus has to offer?

steps.name: Mercenary
steps.text: Y-You're not Ursus!

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: No, I'm not.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: I don't really care to meet those high and mighty lords of yours, but I have a friend who wants to meet you.

steps.name: Tachanka
steps.text: Let me introduce you to Comrade Degtyaryov.
Tachanka pats his machine gun fondly, cracking a smile beneath his heavy helmet.
Gunshots ring through the winter forest, startling a flock of fowlbeasts.
